Metadata.title: Oustians
Metadata.description: The private student app for Obour University for Science and Technology. Meet people, share moments, plan meetups and chat — in Arabic and English.

Home.heroBody: A private space for OUST students — share moments, plan meetups and talk to your people, without the noise.
Home.statusBody: Sign-up, the feed, events, polls and chat are all being built right now. What you see is the app shell: same layout on your phone, dark mode and Arabic included.
Home.languageTitle: Arabic and English, from day one
Home.languageBody: Switch language from the top bar any time — the whole layout flips, navigation included.
Home.privacyBody: Every account is approved by hand, so your feed stays full of real OUST students.

events.title: Events are on the way
events.description: Soon you'll create a meetup, invite your connections and see who's going.

chat.title: Chat is on the way
chat.description: Real-time conversations, photo messages and message requests that keep strangers out.

create.title: Sharing starts here
create.description: Text posts, photos, polls and events will all be created from this screen.

profile.title: Your profile is coming
profile.description: Your photos, your posts and your connections will live here.

settings.title: Settings are coming
settings.description: Language, theme, account privacy, who can message you and blocked accounts — all in one place.

notifications.title: No notifications yet
notifications.description: Connection requests, likes, comments and event updates will show up here.

admin.title: Admin tools
admin.description: Approve new students, manage invite codes and review reports — visible to admins only.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The link may be old, or the page moved. Let's get you back to the feed.
